{"parentUuid":"e2161c72-d21c-412d-8c15-11a7d653d124","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"skill_listing","content":"- update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors (\"from now on when X\", \"each time X\", \"whenever X\", \"before/after X\") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions (\"allow X\", \"add permission\", \"move permission to\"), env vars (\"set X=Y\"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: \"allow npm commands\", \"add bq permission to global settings\", \"move permission to user settings\", \"set DEBUG=true\", \"when claude stops show X\". For simple settings like theme/model, suggest the /config command.\n- keybindings-help: Use when the user wants to customize keyboard shortcuts, rebind keys, add chord bindings, or modify ~/.claude/keybindings.json. Examples: \"rebind ctrl+s\", \"add a chord shortcut\", \"change the submit key\", \"customize keybindings\".\n- simplify: Review changed code for reuse, quality, and efficiency, then fix any issues found.\n- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.\n- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo). Omit the interval to let the model self-pace. - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. \"check the deploy every 5 minutes\", \"keep running /babysit-prs\"). Do NOT invoke for one-off tasks.\n- schedule: Create, update, list, or run scheduled remote agents (routines) that execute on a cron schedule. - When the user wants to schedule a recurring or one-time remote agent (\"run this every Monday\", \"open a cleanup PR for X in 2 weeks\"), or to manage existing routines. ALSO OFFER PROACTIVELY: after you finish work that has a natural future follow-up, end your reply with a one-line offer to schedule a background agent to do it. Strong signals: a feature flag / gate / experiment / staged rollout was just shipped (offer a one-time agent in ~2 weeks to open a cleanup PR or evaluate results), a new alert/monitor was created (offer a recurring agent to triage it), a TODO/migration with a \"remove once X\" condition was left behind (offer a one-time agent to do the removal). Skip the offer for refactors, bug fixes, and anything that is done once it ships. Name a concrete action and cadence (\"in 2 weeks\", \"every Monday\") and only offer when the run just succeeded — do not pitch a schedule for something that has not happened yet.\n- claude-api: Build, debug, and optimize Claude API / Anthropic SDK apps. Apps built with this skill should include prompt caching. Also handles migrating existing Claude API code between Claude model versions (4.5 → 4.6, 4.6 → 4.7, retired-model replacements).\nTRIGGER when: code imports `anthropic`/`@anthropic-ai/sdk`; user asks for the Claude API, Anthropic SDK, or Managed Agents; user adds/modifies/tunes a Claude feature (caching, thinking, compaction, tool use, batch, files, citations, memory) or model (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku) in a file; questions about prompt caching / cache hit rate in an Anthropic SDK project.\nSKIP: file imports `openai`/other-provider SDK, filename like `*-openai.py`/`*-generic.py`, provider-neutral code, general programming/ML.\n- ccs-delegation: Auto-activate CCS CLI delegation for deterministic tasks. Parses user input, auto-selects optimal profile (glm/kimi/custom) from ~/.ccs/config.json, enhances prompts with context, executes via `ccs {profile} -p \"task\"` or `ccs {profile}:continue`, and reports results. Triggers on \"use ccs [task]\" patterns, typo/test/refactor keywords. Excludes complex architecture, security-critical code, performance optimization, breaking changes.\n- attach: Port the Claude Code harness layer from this project to a new project directory. Use when bootstrapping a fresh Claude Code project on the same machine, when peers want to copy the harness, or when verifying layer separation via dry-run. Reads .claude/manifest.yaml; copies harness-tagged artifacts only; excludes stockforge biz + personal layers; generates skeleton CLAUDE.md + manifest at target.\n- crawler-reliability: Build reliable web crawlers for data gathering. Use when implementing scrapers for CafeF, NDH, VietnamBiz, YouTube (yt-dlp), Facebook fanpages, or any external data source. Covers Python/Playwright patterns, retry/backoff, selector robustness, rate limiting, monitoring.\n- ddd-tactical-patterns: Apply DDD tactical patterns (aggregate, entity, value object, repository, domain event, anti-corruption layer) correctly in Python/dataclasses code. Use when designing or implementing domain models, repositories, or cross-bounded-context communication in StockForge's 9 BCs.\n- decompose-work: Split a non-trivial task into deterministic-vs-LLM portions before execution. Use when planning multi-step work where some sub-tasks are mechanical (file ops, regex, count, schema validation) and others require judgment (synthesis, design, ambiguity resolution). Outputs structured plan that maps each portion to the cheapest competent tool. Pairs with capability-map.md (model × effort × task_class grounding) and try-n-approaches (S9 — Karpathy autoresearch loop).\n- evidence-extraction: Extract structured claims from unstructured sources with citation integrity. Use when building extraction pipelines, parsing news articles or KOL transcripts, or anywhere claims are created from raw data. Ensures every claim has source_url, extracted_at, confidence, and verified attribution. Enforces no-LLM-math invariant (I-S1).\n- fastapi-module: Implement FastAPI routers following StockForge conventions. Use when creating a new HTTP endpoint, adding routes, wiring dependency injection, configuring Pydantic DTOs. Covers router boundaries, provider patterns, testing setup. Phase 2+ only — Phase 1 uses Streamlit dashboard directly.\n- grill-maximization: Doctrine for bundling Q&A questions to the human at maximum density per turn (15-20 target, max 25), so each human-in-the-loop touchpoint is information-rich. Use when composing a Q&A bundle for human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, or when deciding whether to ask one question or wait and bundle. Built on the principle that human-in-the-loop time is the scarcest resource in autonomous coding.\n- hook-diagnostics: Inspect hook event lifecycle (state machine + transcript cache + aggregator output) when triaging failed/stuck hooks or auditing self-awareness rollups. Use during sandwich-verifier review, drift investigation, or post-mortem when component-telemetry.jsonl + dispatch.jsonl + sessions-rollup.tsv need cross-checking.\n- obsidian-vault: Search, create, and manage notes in the StockForge Obsidian vault with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index maintenance. Use when adding content to the knowledge base, navigating entities/concepts, or maintaining the raw/wiki separation. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed. Extended with raw/wiki pattern from Karpathy LLM Wiki.\n- postgres-pgvector: Design Postgres schemas with pgvector and TimescaleDB for StockForge. Use when creating migrations, designing tables, writing queries. Covers vector embeddings for semantic search on Vietnamese text, time-series for price/sentiment data, JSONB vs structured columns.\n- promote-rule: Cluster agent-notes.md entries by lexical similarity, propose promotion of recurring rules to deterministic hook (priority 1), skill (priority 2), or charter (priority 3). Use when agent-notes has accumulated ≥10 new rules since last promotion run, or on-demand at phase boundary. Outputs proposal markdown to observations/. Pairs with capability-map.md (writes new task_class entries) and decompose-work (consumes promotion outcomes).\n- prompt-engineering: Design and optimize LLM prompts for StockForge pipeline stages. Use when writing or refining prompts for claim extraction, KOL recommendation extraction, sentiment analysis, thesis synthesis. Covers context assembly, prompt caching strategy, budget-aware prompts, structured output. Enforces no-LLM-math constraint.\n- qa-escalation: File-based Q&A protocol — composes bundle file in human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/, tracks lifecycle (pending → answered → stale → processed), creates URGENT notification when needed. Use when intent classifier recommends OPEN_QA_BUNDLE / ESCALATE_HUMAN, or grill-maximization has a bundle ready to write. Pairs with grill-maximization (composes content) + Track 5 hooks (auto-move stale).\n- session-memory-l0-l1: Extract structured memories (L0 quick metadata + L1 deep) from a Claude Code session JSONL transcript. L0 is pure regex (file paths, commands, errors, failures incl. Vietnamese phrases, next step). L1 ships the prompt builder + response parser + 15+35 head/tail windowing — caller dispatches the LLM (no auto-invoke in Phase 0). Plus cleanText harness-stripper + TranscriptCache (mtime+size dual-check + LRU). Use when ingesting a session for memory promotion, computing what files/commands/failures the session touched, or preparing an offline LLM extraction.\n- spec-dual-layer: Write specifications with dual-layer structure (business narrative + agent contract). Use when authoring new specs, refining existing specs, or understanding the spec template. Ensures both human stakeholder needs and agent execution needs are served.\n- spec-to-wiki: Convert raw specifications to Obsidian wiki format with wikilinks, frontmatter, and index updates. Use when adding a new spec to the knowledge base, or when regenerating wiki view after spec changes. Maintains raw as source of truth, wiki as navigable view.\n- sync-pull: On-demand confidence-score lookup before a SCOPE+/ARCH/IMPL decision. Reads agent-workspace/memory/sync-tracker/state.tsv + weights.yaml; surfaces the relevant category's score, tier, must-grill flag, and the decision-class threshold. Output drives \"self-decide vs grill\" choice. Use whenever an agent is about to commit a non-trivial decision and needs to ground confidence in historical hit rate per Charter Principle 8 (Calibration over confidence).\n- test-pyramid-balance: Balance unit, integration, and E2E tests properly in Python/pytest. Use when deciding what test to write, reviewing test coverage, or rebalancing skewed test suite. Covers test pyramid shape, BDD vs unit tests, when to use what. Includes stock-domain-specific test categories.\n- try-n-approaches: Karpathy autoresearch outer-loop framing — given a task or signal, generate ≥3 distinct approaches (DEEPEN / BROADEN / ABANDON families), pick one per cheap-first ordering, attach a deterministic metric function (per L-S12-1), and write the experiment frame to learning-data/loop/. Use when an open question surfaces from drift / dogfood / sync-grilling and you need to commit a measurable next step. Pairs with decompose-work (deterministic-vs-LLM split per approach) + capability-map (model × effort grounding) + promote-rule (consumes outcomes).\n- ubiquitous-language: Extract a DDD-style ubiquitous language glossary from the current conversation or domain area. Use when starting work on a new bounded context, when new domain terms emerge, or when verifying consistency between business language and code. Adapted from mattpocock/skills, MIT licensed.\n- user-prompt-intake: Hybrid intent classifier — main session lite-detects trivial prompts, dispatches intent-classifier subagent for complex ones. Use whenever a new user prompt lands (chat or file in human-workspace/user_prompt/) and you need to route the work. Built for full-autonomous loop where every prompt must be classified before action.\n- write-a-skill: Create new Claude Code skills with proper structure, progressive disclosure, and discoverability. Use when extracting a pattern from multiple sessions into a reusable skill, or when user asks to formalize a technique. Everything here represents **agent state, decisions, plans, observations, learning**. Agents WRITE here freely (within constitution rules); humans READ here but normally do not edit.\n\nThis separation exists to prevent two failure modes from orch:\n1. **Charter drift via shared-workspace mutation** (orch CF-DOGFOOD-2)\n2. **Human cognitive overload from dense session logs** (UP02 §1.3 — \"human đối mặt hàng chục spec/document quá tải nếu không sắp xếp khoa học\")\n\nThe agent owns this directory but must keep it AUDITABLE — every artifact provenance-linked, every decision sourced.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Lifecycle |\n|---|---|---|\n| `constitution/` | **IMMUTABLE without explicit user approval**. Charter-tier rules (autonomous-protocol, model-routing, identity-scope, etc.). Track 7 produces drafts in `proposals/`; user explicit approve to move here. | Edit denied by .claude/settings.json; Write only via human approval gate |\n| `memory/project.md` | High-level project state; phase tracker; ADRs (last 5). Update on phase boundaries + architectural decisions. | Long-lived; trim to most recent decisions |\n| `memory/current-execution.md` | **THE single routing source of truth**. Active phase + active session + autonomous_mode flag + routing table. Read FIRST every session. | Long-lived; updated each session boundary |\n| `memory/agent-notes.md` | Learned rules from real experience (post-mortem / drift / user correction). Append-only mostly. | Long-lived |\n| `memory/decisions/` | Sequential ADRs (`NNN-<slug>.md`) + `_template.md` + `README.md` index. 12-field schema (Track 2). | Append-only; supersession via status field |\n| `memory/sessions/` | One file per session: `YYYY-MM-DD-session-N.md`. What happened, decisions made, files touched. | Append-only |\n| `memory/observations/` | Subagent return artifacts (per Track 6 spec). Each subagent writes one observation file describing what it did. | Append; cleaned periodically by aggregator |\n| `memory/checkpoints/` | Session handoff state for self-reboot (Track 5). `latest.md` is canonical pointer; timestamped historical files retained. | Append + latest.md updated each checkpoint |\n| `memory/patterns-discovered/` | Pattern mining outputs (Track 0 — DONE) + ongoing pattern catalog. | Append; significant patterns promoted to constitution |\n| `memory/drift-logs/` | Drift-check (DR1-DR12) results; runs on hook + on-demand. | Time-series append |\n| `memory/post-mortems/` | After significant failure or thesis-revoked event: what failed, root cause, prevention rule. | Append |\n| `memory/thesis-log/` | Stock-domain thesis exploration entries. Read-only for IMPL sessions. | Append + revisited per calibration |\n| `memory/sync-tracker/` | Track 8a output: Confidence Score SQLite + weights.yaml + auto-rendered `_index.md`. | Live updated by hooks |\n| `memory/self-awareness/` | Track 9 output: model × effort × thinking profile cards + known-issues + best-practices. | Live updated by Stop-hook aggregator |\n| `memory/mistake-log.md` | Track 7 deliverable: structured failure catalog. What went wrong / Root cause / Prevention rule / Severity. | Append; pre-flight read by all agents |\n| `session-plans/pending/` | Plans authored, awaiting execution. Phase 0 plan lives here. | Move to `completed/` when done |\n| `session-plans/completed/` | Executed plans; archived for reference + retrospective input. | Append |\n| `quality-reports/{deterministic,probabilistic,drift-reports}/` | Tier-1/2/3 gate outputs (CLAUDE.md § Quality Gates). | Per-run files |\n| `ubiquitous-language/` | DDD glossary + domain-mapping + drift-log. Stockforge stock-domain vocabulary. | Append; canonical via `/drill-me` |\n| `calibration/` | Empirical hit-rate data per signal type. Confidence claims MUST trace here (CLAUDE.md hard rule). | Append per thesis post-mortem |\n| `research/` | Research notes from `research-scanner` subagent dispatches (e.g., reference-repo studies). | Append |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Constitution is immutable absent explicit human approval.** `Edit/Write` to `agent-workspace/constitution/**` is in `.claude/settings.json` deny list. Track 7 writes constitution drafts to `proposals/`; user explicit approve moves them.\n\n2. **`memory/decisions/` is append-mostly + supersession-status.** Don't delete decisions; mark `status: superseded-by-D-NNN` to revoke. Sequential numbering (`001`, `002`, ...) — don't reuse numbers.\n\n3. **`current-execution.md` is the routing source-of-truth.** No skill, agent, or command may hardcode phase paths or session paths from memory; resolve via this file. Stale paths in CLAUDE.md or skills = anti-pattern.\n\n4. **Never edit `obsidian-vault/raw/`.** Immutable. Vault writes only to `wiki/`. (Established in stockforge CLAUDE.md.)\n\n5. **Provenance is mandatory.** Every decision file references its source (human prompt / spec clause / drift detection / agent inference). Every thesis cites source + as-of date (I-S2). (Otherwise they're informal notes, not contracts.)\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nPer `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` (Track 7) and stockforge `CLAUDE.md` § Session Protocol:\n\n1. **`memory/current-execution.md`** — first; resolve active track\n2. **`memory/project.md`** — project state\n3. **`memory/checkpoints/latest.md`** if a recent checkpoint exists (within last 24h) — resume context\n4. **`memory/agent-notes.md`** — learned rules\n5. **`memory/mistake-log.md`** — pre-flight failure catalog\n6. **Last 3 files in `memory/sessions/`** — recent context\n7. **`session-plans/pending/<active-plan>.md`** — current plan\n8. **Relevant constitution files** as task demands (don't load all every session)\n9. **Relevant skills + agents + commands** as task demands\n\n---\n\n## Anti-Patterns to Avoid\n\n(From `memory/patterns-discovered/SYNTHESIS.md` § 6, full catalog 23 items. {"parentUuid":"20edead9-1fcf-4bd1-bbf9-38b7cf99ed2f","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"nested_memory","path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","content":{"path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md","type":"Project","content":"# human-workspace/ — Contract\n\n> **Audience**: agents reading anything inside `human-workspace/`.\n> **Established**: Decision 002 § Track 1 (Workspace Dualism Foundation).\n\n## Identity\n\n`human-workspace/` is the **human-authored authority** layer. Everything here represents **human decisions, scope, intent, and verification**. Agents READ this directory as authoritative; agents do NOT WRITE here except in one designated channel (`q-and-a/pending/` — where agents post questions for human to answer).\n\nThis separation exists because of a failure mode observed in the orch sister project (orch `decisions/040`, post-mortem CF-DOGFOOD-2): when human and agent share a single workspace without contract, agent silently overrides human-CRITICAL items via technical-defer logic. The user explicitly raised this concern in `human-workspace/user_prompt/20260429_02_init.txt` §1.1.\n\n---\n\n## Subdirectories\n\n| Path | Purpose | Who writes |\n|---|---|---|\n| `user_prompt/` | Human's mid-flight scope/idea drops. Naming: `YYYYMMDD_NN_<slug>.txt`. Files are immutable post-creation (audit trail). | **Human only**. Agent: read-only. |\n| `decisions/` | Human's strategic decisions (e.g., scope-lock, charter-revision-trigger, peer-share authorization). Format: `D-H-<NNN>-<slug>.md`. | **Human only**. Agent: read-only. |\n| `q-and-a/pending/` | **The ONE channel where agent writes inside human-workspace**. Agent drops Q&A bundles per Grill Maximization doctrine; human responds inline or moves to `answered/`. | **Both** (agent writes new bundles; human writes answers). |\n| `q-and-a/answered/` | Q&A bundles human has answered (with answers inline). Agent reads answers and acts. Archive forever; provenance trail. | **Human moves** (drag from `pending/`); agent reads. |\n| `q-and-a/stale/` | Pending bundles that exceeded their `expected_answer_by` (default 24h, urgent 4h). Auto-moved by SessionStart hook (Track 5). | **Hook moves**; both read. |\n| `notifications/` | Agent push to human — summaries, alerts, milestones. Format: `N-<TS>-<level>-<slug>.md`. Levels: INFO / SUMMARY / ALERT. | **Agent writes**; human reads. |\n\n---\n\n## Contract Rules (BINDING)\n\n1. **Agent NEVER writes to `user_prompt/` or `decisions/`.** Permission deny. If something feels like a human decision but the human hasn't written it, dispatch a Q&A bundle into `q-and-a/pending/` instead.\n\n2. **`user_prompt/` files are immutable post-creation.** Agent never deletes, renames, or edits these files. They are the audit trail of human interventions.\n\n3. **Q&A bundle format** (per Track 4 spec): YAML frontmatter (`id`, `topic`, `opened_at`, `expected_answer_by`, `priority`, `related_decisions`, `status`) + question body + answer-fill section. Each bundle = up to 25 questions per Grill Maximization doctrine; split if more.\n\n4. **Agent does not move files between `q-and-a/{pending,answered,stale}/`** — that's human's role (or hook's, in case of stale). Agent only WRITES new pending bundles and READS answers.\n\n5. **Notifications are read-only for human.** Human shouldn't edit `notifications/*` files; if disagreement with notification content, drop a `user_prompt/` instead. Notifications are the agent's account of events.\n\n6. **Provenance pointers**: every `agent-workspace/memory/decisions/D-<NNN>` should reference its source `human-workspace/user_prompt/<file>` or `human-workspace/decisions/D-H-<NNN>` if the agent's decision derives from human input.\n\n7. **No multi-tenancy in this directory.** Per identity-scope.md (Track 7), stockforge is single-tenant Phase 0-5; if peer share happens it's via git-fork, each peer has their own `human-workspace/` per fork.\n\n---\n\n## Reading Priority for Agent\n\nWhen loading session context (per `agent-workspace/constitution/autonomous-protocol.md` Track 7):\n\n1. **All `user_prompt/*.txt`** — every prompt, not just most recent. Per orch lesson (decision-040 USER-CRITICAL tier): never silently defer human-CRITICAL items.\n2. **All `decisions/*.md`** — human's strategic decisions are above charter principles in priority; charter is below human (charter was authored by human in the first place).\n3. **Latest `q-and-a/answered/*`** — recent answers update agent's understanding.\n4. **Open `q-and-a/pending/*`** — flag if waiting on human answers.\n5. **Recent `notifications/*`** (last 7 days) — for situational awareness.\n\n---\n\n## Agent Self-Check\n\nBefore writing to `human-workspace/q-and-a/pending/`, ask:\n- Is this question genuinely something the human must decide? (Charter principle / Charter-affecting / SCOPE-affecting / above ARCH-tier confidence threshold)\n- Have I already grilled this in a recent bundle? (Don't ask twice; don't pollute pending/)\n- Am I bundling per Grill Maximization (target 15-20 questions, max 25)? Or splintering across many small bundles?\n\nIf the answer to any is \"I'm not sure\" — DON'T write the bundle. Either answer it yourself with charter-principle reasoning + log decision, or wait until ambiguity clears.\n","contentDiffersFromDisk":false},"displayPath":"human-workspace\\CLAUDE.md"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"2d020ea3-5a44-4649-8668-94f23ae1e101","timestamp":"2026-05-01T00:37:06.639Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"7bf27696-2c05-47b0-b800-b80ca0c05110","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

extracted by LLM\n233\t    mentioned_tickers: list[Ticker]\n234\t    mentioned_sectors: list[Sector]\n235\t    sentiment: Sentiment      # categorical, not numeric (Rule 7)\n236\t    extractor_model: str\n237\t    extractor_version: str\n238\t    extracted_at: datetime\n239\t    source_text_excerpt: str\n240\t    confidence_extracted: float\n241\t```\n242\t\n243\t### LLM Role\n244\t\n245\t- **Extract structured claims** from unstructured news\n246\t- **Classify sentiment** categorically (STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL | BEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH)\n247\t- **Identify mentioned entities** (tickers, sectors, people)\n248\t- **Detect contradictions** between sources reporting same event\n249\t- **Cluster related stories** (same event covered by multiple sources)\n250\t\n251\tLLM does NOT:\n252\t- Generate sentiment scores numerically\n253\t- Predict price impact (that's BC-8 Analysis with deterministic models)\n254\t- Produce summaries that displace original (copyright + accuracy)\n255\t\n256\t### Lead Time\n257\t\n258\tReal-time. Pipeline polls every 5-15 min for new articles.\n259\t\n260\t### Reliability\n261\t\n262\tHigh but variable:\n263\t- Major outlets (CafeF, Vietstock): high reliability for facts, watch for \"PR disguised as news\"\n264\t- Smaller outlets: variable; calibrate per source over time\n265\t- Broker reports: have inherent bias (broker has positions); track which broker is right for which sector\n266\t- Government docs: high reliability for facts, low for interpretation\n267\t\n268\t## B.3 Tier 3: Influence Network ⭐\n269\t\n270\t### Sources"}]},"uuid":"abe66797-f4a0-4a4f-bcee-7b35676a1c0d","timestamp":"2026-05-01T00:37:39.099Z","toolUseResult":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\specs\\tier1-strategic\\001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md","content":"## B.2 Tier 2: Official Narrative\n\n### Sources\n\n**Required**:\n- CafeF (cafef.vn) — most popular VN financial news\n- Vietstock News (vietstock.vn) — second most popular\n- NDH (nhipcaudautu.vn) — quality analysis\n- VietnamBiz (vietnambiz.vn) — business focus\n- Đầu Tư Chứng Khoán (tinnhanhchungkhoan.vn)\n\n**Source-specific (companies/sectors)**:\n- Company official announcements via HOSE/HNX disclosure portals\n- Broker reports (SSI, HSC, VCSC, VND, FPTS) — public summaries\n\n**Government/Regulatory**:\n- SBV (State Bank of Vietnam) announcements\n- MoF (Ministry of Finance) policy documents\n- Quốc hội / Chính phủ document portals\n\n### Data Categories\n\n```python\n# Stored in BC-5 News Stream\nclass NewsArticle:\n    article_id: str\n    source: str               # \"cafef\", \"vietstock\", etc\n    url: str\n    title: str\n    body_excerpt: str         # full body in R2\n    published_at: datetime\n    ingested_at: datetime\n    \nclass ExtractedClaim:\n    claim_id: str\n    article_id: str\n    claim_text: str           # extracted by LLM\n    mentioned_tickers: list[Ticker]\n    mentioned_sectors: list[Sector]\n    sentiment: Sentiment      # categorical, not numeric (Rule 7)\n    extractor_model: str\n    extractor_version: str\n    extracted_at: datetime\n    source_text_excerpt: str\n    confidence_extracted: float\n```\n\n### LLM Role\n\n- **Extract structured claims** from unstructured news\n- **Classify sentiment** categorically (STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL | BEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH)\n- **Identify mentioned entities** (tickers, sectors, people)\n- **Detect contradictions** between sources reporting same event\n- **Cluster related stories** (same event covered by multiple sources)\n\nLLM does NOT:\n- Generate sentiment scores numerically\n- Predict price impact (that's BC-8 Analysis with deterministic models)\n- Produce summaries that displace original (copyright + accuracy)\n\n### Lead Time\n\nReal-time. Pipeline polls every 5-15 min for new articles.\n\n### Reliability\n\nHigh but variable:\n- Major outlets (CafeF, Vietstock): high reliability for facts, watch for \"PR disguised as news\"\n- Smaller outlets: variable; calibrate per source over time\n- Broker reports: have inherent bias (broker has positions); track which broker is right for which sector\n- Government docs: high reliability for facts, low for interpretation\n\n## B.3 Tier 3: Influence Network ⭐\n\n### Sources","numLines":75,"startLine":196,"totalLines":611}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"0a720115-92e6-425a-8d94-40c829617a6e","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"7bf27696-2c05-47b0-b800-b80ca0c05110","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

Schema NOT NULL constraints. What does 80% mean? Is it calibrated to anything?\n165\t\n166\t### The Rule\n167\t\n168\tSentiment scores are categorical, not numeric:\n169\t- `STRONGLY_BULLISH | BULLISH | NEUTRAL | BEARISH | STRONGLY_BEARISH`\n170\t\n171\tPlus extracted features:\n172\t- `mentioned_tickers: list[Ticker]`\n173\t- `key_phrases: list[str]`\n174\t- `tone_indicators: list[str]` (e.g., \"uses superlatives\", \"compares to leader\", \"raises concern\")\n175\t\n176\tAggregation to \"sentiment score\" happens in code, not LLM:\n177\t- e.g., `sentiment_score = (bullish_count - bearish_count) / total_count` over a time window\n178\t\n179\t### The Enforcement\n180\t\n181\tSentiment LLM tasks return enum, not number. Application layer converts to score with explicit formula. Backtest can validate which scoring formula correlates with subsequent price moves.\n182\t\n183\t---\n184\t\n185\t## Rule 8: Anti-Look-Ahead in News & Sentiment\n186\t\n187\t### The Problem\n188\t\n189\tYou backtest \"buy stocks with positive news momentum\". But the news article from Jan 15 might have been published 8pm — too late to act. Or the sentiment was scored 3 days later when more context was available.\n190\t\n191\t### The Rule\n192\t\n193\tEvery news/sentiment record has:\n194\t- `published_at` — when source published it (best estimate)\n195\t- `ingested_at` — when our system saw it\n196\t- `scored_at` — when sentiment was computed\n197\t\n198\tBacktest filters: `WHERE published_at <= as_of_date AND scored_at <= as_of_date AND published_at + acting_lag <= action_date`\n199\t\n200\tWhere `acting_lag` = realistic time between news and possible trade (e.g., next day open if published after market close).\n201\t\n202\t### The Enforcement\n203\t\n204\tNews/sentiment repository has only `get_known_as_of(ticker, as_of_date)` method for backtest. Fundamental;\nfinancial-data-protocol.md Rule 1 + Rule 4 + Rule 5 + Rule 6;\nspecs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md § B.1.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import UTC, date, datetime\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Currency, Money, SourceProvider, Ticker\nfrom packages.domain.fundamental.value_objects import LineItemKey, StatementType\n\n__all__ = [\"FinancialStatement\", \"FinancialStatementInvariantError\"]\n\n\nclass FinancialStatementInvariantError(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Raised when a FinancialStatement is constructed with values violating\n    Rule 1 / Rule 4 / Rule 5 / Rule 6 / I-S1.\n    \"\"\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass FinancialStatement:\n    \"\"\"Immutable Vietnamese financial-statement record. Rich entity per\n    architecture.md § Domain Model Rules.\n\n    `line_items` is a frozen-by-convention dict (typed as Mapping for read-only\n    intent; Python doesn't ship a frozendict). Mutating the dict post-construct\n    breaks the dataclass equality contract — callers MUST treat it as immutable.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    ticker: Ticker\n    statement_type: StatementType\n    period_end: date\n    filing_date: date\n    ingested_at: datetime\n    line_items: Mapping[str, Money]\n    source_provider: SourceProvider\n    sector: str | None = None\n    restated_at: datetime | None = None\n    fiscal_period_label: str = field(default=\"\")\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        today = datetime.now(UTC).date()\n        if self.period_end > today:\n            raise FinancialStatementInvariantError(\n                f\"period_end {self.period_end} > today {today} (look-ahead bias; Rule 1 / I-S2)\"\n            )\n        if self.filing_date < self.period_end:\n            raise FinancialStatementInvariantError(\n                f\"filing_date {self.filing_date} < period_end {self.period_end} \"\n                f\"(filing cannot precede the period it reports; Rule 1)\"\n            )\n        if self.ingested_at.date() < self.filing_date:\n            raise FinancialStatementInvariantError(\n                f\"ingested_at {self.ingested_at.date()} < filing_date {self.filing_date} \"\n                f\"(ingestion cannot precede filing; Rule 1)\"\n            )\n        if not self.line_items:\n            raise FinancialStatementInvariantError(\n                f\"{self.statement_type.value} for {self.ticker} has empty line_items (Rule 6 / I-S1)\"\n            )\n        currencies = {m.currency for m in self.line_items.values()}\n        if len(currencies) > 1:\n            raise FinancialStatementInvariantError(\n                f\"line_items currency mismatch {sorted(c.value for c in currencies)} \"\n                f\"(I-S6 + Rule 5; FinancialStatement is single-currency)\"\n            )\n\n    @property\n    def currency(self) -> Currency:\n        first = next(iter(self.line_items.values()))\n        return first.currency\n\n    def get_line_item(self, key: str | LineItemKey) -> Money | None:\n        \"\"\"Return the Money value for `key` if present, else None.\n\n        Accepts both raw str and LineItemKey enum so call sites can read either\n        the canonical key (preferred for ratio_service) or the raw string (for\n        adapter-time lookup before normalization is complete).\n        \"\"\"\n        lookup_key = key.value if isinstance(key, LineItemKey) else key\n        return self.line_items.get(lookup_key)\n\n    def has_line_items(self, *keys: str | LineItemKey) -> bool:\n        \"\"\"True if every named key is present in line_items (and value Money).\"\"\"\n        return all(self.get_line_item(key) is not None for key in keys)\n","numLines":108,"startLine":1,"totalLines":108}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"8c49e803-5a79-40d3-a93f-1e99f56fb644","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"7bf27696-2c05-47b0-b800-b80ca0c05110","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

def get_as_of(\n        self,\n        ticker: Ticker,\n        as_of_date: date,\n        statement_type: StatementType | None = None,\n    ) -> list[FinancialStatement]:\n        if statement_type is None:\n            sql = \"\"\"\n                SELECT * FROM financial_statements\n                WHERE ticker = ?\n                  AND period_end <= ?\n                  AND filing_date <= ?\n                ORDER BY period_end ASC, statement_type ASC\n            \"\"\"\n            params: tuple[object, ...] = (\n                ticker.symbol, as_of_date.isoformat(), as_of_date.isoformat(),\n            )\n        else:\n            sql = \"\"\"\n                SELECT * FROM financial_statements\n                WHERE ticker = ?\n                  AND statement_type = ?\n                  AND period_end <= ?\n                  AND filing_date <= ?\n                ORDER BY period_end ASC\n            \"\"\"\n            params = (\n                ticker.symbol, statement_type.value,\n                as_of_date.isoformat(), as_of_date.isoformat(),\n            )\n        return self._query(sql, params)\n\n    def get_latest(self, ticker: Ticker) -> FinancialStatement | None:\n        rows = self._query(\n            \"SELECT * FROM financial_statements WHERE ticker = ? \"\n            \"ORDER BY period_end DESC, filing_date DESC LIMIT 1\",\n            (ticker.symbol,),\n        )\n        return rows[0] if rows else None\n\n    def count(self) -> int:\n        with closing(sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path))) as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial_statements\")\n            return int(cur.fetchone()[0])\n\n    def count_for(self, ticker: Ticker) -> int:\n        with closing(sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path))) as conn:\n            cur = conn.execute(\n                \"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM financial_statements WHERE ticker = ?\",\n                (ticker.symbol,),\n            )\n            return int(cur.fetchone()[0])\n\n    def _query(self, sql: str, params: tuple[object, ...]) -> list[FinancialStatement]:\n        with closing(sqlite3.connect(str(self.db_path))) as conn:\n            conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n            cur = conn.execute(sql, params)\n            return [self._from_row(dict(r)) for r in cur.fetchall()]\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _to_row(s: FinancialStatement) -> tuple[object, ...]:\n        line_items_json = json.dumps(\n            {k: str(v.amount) for k, v in s.line_items.items()},\n            ensure_ascii=False,\n        )\n        return (\n            s.ticker.symbol,\n            s.statement_type.value,\n            s.period_end.isoformat(),\n     s.restated_at.isoformat() if s.restated_at is not None else None,\n            s.fiscal_period_label,\n        )\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _from_row(row: dict[str, object]) -> k, v in raw_items.items()}\n        restated_raw = row.get(\"restated_at\")\n        return FinancialStatement(\n            ticker=Ticker(str(row[\"ticker\"])),\n            statement_type=StatementType(str(row[\"statement_type\"])),\n            period_end=date.fromisoformat(str(row[\"period_end\"])),\n            filing_date=date.fromisoformat(str(row[\"filing_date\"])),\n            ingested_at=datetime.fromisoformat(str(row[\"ingested_at\"])),\n            line_items=line_items,\n The\nservice depends only on the LlmExtractorPort Protocol (lives in the\napplication layer) and a ClaimRepository to persist results. Concrete\nadapters (`ClaudeLlmExtractor`) are wired at the CLI / use-case layer.\n\nThe service is the single place that:\n1. Persists results via the repository.\n\nSource: specs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md § B.2;\nagent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rule 6.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom collections.abc import Iterable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom packages.domain.news.models import ExtractedClaim, NewsArticle\nfrom packages.domain.news.repositories import ClaimRepository\n\n__all__ = [\"ClaimExtractionService\", \"LlmExtractorProtocol\"]\n\n\nfrom typing import Protocol\n\n\nclass LlmExtractorProtocol(Protocol):\n    \"\"\"Mirror of packages.application.news.ports.LlmExtractorPort, declared\n    here so the domain service has zero dependency on the application layer.\n\n    The application port and this Protocol are structurally identical; mypy\n    accepts a concrete implementer of either in this slot.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def extract(self, article: NewsArticle) -> list[ExtractedClaim]:\n        ...\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass ClaimExtractionService:\n    \"\"\"Drive LLM-extraction over a stream of articles. {"parentUuid":"8b56d806-2c6c-45a6-8f7f-382524d750f0","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-4-7","id":"msg_01GWRbhtkyyCkjiCpYzGr5Cu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_017vfvVAwpTbuP8PZjqRhGFL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge\\packages\\infrastructure\\news\\cafef_scraper.py","content":"\"\"\"CafeFScraper — fixture-friendly CafeF article scraper.\n\nPhase 2 thin slice (S36 Track D). Two design constraints drive the shape:\n\n1. **Fixture-driven CI**: tests inject recorded HTML via the `fetcher` callable\n   so CI never hits cafef.vn. The default fetcher (`_httpx_fetcher`) uses\n   httpx with a 1-req/2-sec rate limit per spec-T1-001 § B.9 (ToS-respecting).\n2. **Robust selector failure**: CafeF mutates HTML quarterly; we extract via\n   resilient BeautifulSoup queries and emit `ScrapedArticle` only when title +\n   URL + body excerpt are non-empty. Failures degrade to skip-with-log, not\n   raise (vendor drift L-S28-1 doctrine).\n\nSource: agent-workspace/.claude/skills/crawler-reliability/SKILL.md;\nspecs/tier1-strategic/001-four-tier-signal-architecture.md § B.2 + § B.9;\nagent-workspace/constitution/financial-data-protocol.md Rule 8.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport hashlib\nimport time\nfrom collections.abc import Callable, Iterable\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, field\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom typing import cast\n\nfrom packages.contracts import Ticker\nfrom packages.domain.news.models import NewsArticle\n\n__all__ = [\"CafeFScraper\", \"ScrapedArticle\"]\n\n\n_RATE_LIMIT_SECONDS = 2.0\n_DEFAULT_BASE_URL = \"https://cafef.vn\"\n_DEFAULT_USER_AGENT = (\n    \"stockforge-research-bot/0.0.1 (+contact: nathanleewindy@gmail.com)\"\n)\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)\nclass ScrapedArticle:\n    \"\"\"Raw scrape output before NewsArticle promotion. Holds the verbatim HTML\n    body so the LLM extractor can quote source_text_excerpt grounded in the\n    full body (Rule 6).\n    \"\"\"\n\n    url: str\n    title: str\n    body_html: str\n    body_text: str\n    published_at: datetime\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass CafeFScraper:\n    \"\"\"Scrape CafeF listing + article pages.\n\n    `fetcher` signature: (url: str) -> str (HTML body). Default uses httpx\n    with retries; tests inject a closure over a fixture dict.\n    `clock` signature: () -> datetime; default returns `datetime.now(UTC)`.\n    Tests pass a frozen clock for deterministic ingested_at.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    fetcher: Callable[[str], str]\n    clock: Callable[[], datetime] = field(\n        default_factory=lambda: lambda: datetime.now(UTC)\n    )\n    base_url: str = _DEFAULT_BASE_URL\n    rate_limit_seconds: float = _RATE_LIMIT_SECONDS\n    sleeper: Callable[[float], None] = time.sleep\n\n    def __post_init__(self) -> None:\n        self._last_fetch_at: float = 0.0\n\n    def discover(self, listing_path: str, max_articles: int = 50) -> list[str]:\n        \"\"\"Return article URLs from a listing page.\n\n        `listing_path` is e.g. \"/thi-truong-chung-khoan.chn\" — the section\n        landing page. Discovery scrapes the listing for anchor hrefs ending\n        \".chn\" (CafeF convention) and returns absolute URLs deduped.\n        \"\"\"\n        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup\n\n        html = self._rate_limited_fetch(self._absolute(listing_path))\n        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, \"html.parser\")\n        urls: list[str] = []\n        seen: set[str] = set()\n        for anchor in soup.find_all(\"a\", href=True):\n            href = cast(str, anchor[\"href\"])\n            if not href.endswith(\".chn\"):\n                continue\n            absolute = self._absolute(href)\n            if absolute in seen:\n                continue\n            seen.add(absolute)\n            urls.append(absolute)\n            if len(urls) >= max_articles:\n                break\n        return urls\n\n    def fetch_article(self, url: str) -> ScrapedArticle | None:\n        \"\"\"Fetch + parse a single article. Returns None on parse failure\n        (vendor drift L-S28-1 doctrine — degrade gracefully).\n        \"\"\"\n        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup\n\n        try:\n            html = self._rate_limited_fetch(url)\n        except Exception:\n            return None\n        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, \"html.parser\")\n        title_tag = soup.find(\"h1\")\n        if title_tag is None or not title_tag.get_text(strip=True):\n            return None\n        title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True)\n        body_container = (\n            soup.find(\"div\", class_=\"detail-content\")\n            or soup.find(\"div\", class_=\"contentdetail\")\n            or soup.find(\"article\")\n        )\n        if body_container is None:\n            return None\n        body_text = body_container.get_text(separator=\"\\n\", strip=True)\n        if not body_text:\n            return None\n        published_at = self._parse_published_at(soup) or self.clock()\n        return ScrapedArticle(\n            url=url,\n            title=title,\n            body_html=str(body_container),\n            body_text=body_text,\n            published_at=published_at,\n        )\n\n    def to_news_article(\n        self,\n        scraped: ScrapedArticle,\n        ticker_universe: Iterable[Ticker],\n        excerpt_chars: int = 4000,\n    ) -> NewsArticle:\n        \"\"\"Promote a ScrapedArticle to a NewsArticle, attaching coarse-scan\n        ticker mentions. The coarse scan looks for the symbol verbatim in\n        title + body_text (case-sensitive — VN tickers are uppercase).\n        \"\"\"\n        haystack = f\"{scraped.title}\\n{scraped.body_text}\"\n        mentioned = tuple(\n            t for t in ticker_universe if t.symbol in haystack\n        )\n        article_id = self._article_id(scraped.url)\n        return NewsArticle(\n            article_id=article_id,\n            source=\"cafef\",\n            source_url=scraped.url,\n            title=scraped.title,\n            body_excerpt=scraped.body_text[:excerpt_chars],\n            published_at=scraped.published_at,\n            ingested_at=self.clock(),\n            mentioned_tickers=mentioned,\n            language=\"vi\",\n        )\n\n    def _rate_limited_fetch(self, url: str) -> str:\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_fetch_at\n        if elapsed < self.rate_limit_seconds:\n            self.sleeper(self.rate_limit_seconds - elapsed)\n        try:\n            return self.fetcher(url)\n        finally:\n            self._last_fetch_at = time.monotonic()\n\n    def _absolute(self, href: str) -> str:\n        if href.startswith(\"http://\") or href.startswith(\"https://\"):\n            return href\n        if href.startswith(\"/\"):\n            return f\"{self.base_url}{href}\"\n        return f\"{self.base_url}/{href}\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _parse_published_at(soup: object) -> datetime | None:\n        \"\"\"Best-effort `<span class=\"pdate\">` or `<meta name=\"pubdate\">` parse.\n        Returns None when no recognised tag is found — the scraper falls back\n        to the wall clock at ingest time.\n        \"\"\"\n        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, Tag\n\n        if not isinstance(soup, BeautifulSoup):\n            return None\n        for selector in (\n            (\"span\", {\"class\": \"pdate\"}),\n            (\"span\", {\"class\": \"date\"}),\n            (\"meta\", {\"name\": \"pubdate\"}),\n        ):\n            tag_name, attrs = selector\n            tag = soup.find(tag_name, attrs=attrs)\n            if not isinstance(tag, Tag):\n                continue\n            text = (\n                cast(str, tag.get(\"content\"))\n                if tag.name == \"meta\"\n                else tag.get_text(strip=True)\n            )\n            if not text:\n                continue\n            for fmt in (\"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S\", \"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M\", \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"):\n                try:\n                    return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).replace(tzinfo=UTC)\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n        return None\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _article_id(url: str) -> str:\n        return hashlib.sha256(url.encode(\"utf-8\")).hexdigest()[:16]\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3273,"cache_read_input_tokens":110830,"output_tokens":3416,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3273,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":3416,"cache_read_input_tokens":110830,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3273,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3273},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaavHE559BDccX1ypvSpV","type":"assistant","uuid":"8b60cb6b-1b2f-4124-ae8d-ce346fb119e3","timestamp":"2026-05-01T00:41:16.067Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"7bf27696-2c05-47b0-b800-b80ca0c05110","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

Returns None on parse failure\n        (vendor drift L-S28-1 doctrine — degrade gracefully).\n        \"\"\"\n        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup\n\n        try:\n            html = self._rate_limited_fetch(url)\n        except Exception:\n            return None\n        soup = BeautifulSoup(html, \"html.parser\")\n        title_tag = soup.find(\"h1\")\n        if title_tag is None or not title_tag.get_text(strip=True):\n            return None\n        title = title_tag.get_text(strip=True)\n        body_container = (\n            soup.find(\"div\", class_=\"detail-content\")\n            or soup.find(\"div\", class_=\"contentdetail\")\n            or soup.find(\"article\")\n        )\n        if body_container is None:\n            return None\n        body_text = body_container.get_text(separator=\"\\n\", strip=True)\n        if not body_text:\n            return None\n        published_at = self._parse_published_at(soup) or self.clock()\n        return ScrapedArticle(\n            url=url,\n            title=title,\n            body_html=str(body_container),\n            body_text=body_text,\n            published_at=published_at,\n        )\n\n    def to_news_article(\n        self,\n        scraped: ScrapedArticle,\n        ticker_universe: Iterable[Ticker],\n        excerpt_chars: int = 4000,\n    ) -> NewsArticle:\n        \"\"\"Promote a ScrapedArticle to a NewsArticle, attaching coarse-scan\n        ticker mentions. The coarse scan looks for the symbol verbatim in\n        title + body_text (case-sensitive — VN tickers are uppercase).\n        \"\"\"\n        haystack = f\"{scraped.title}\\n{scraped.body_text}\"\n        mentioned = tuple(\n            t for t in ticker_universe if t.symbol in haystack\n        )\n        article_id = self._article_id(scraped.url)\n        return NewsArticle(\n            article_id=article_id,\n            source=\"cafef\",\n            source_url=scraped.url,\n            title=scraped.title,\n            body_excerpt=scraped.body_text[:excerpt_chars],\n            published_at=scraped.published_at,\n            ingested_at=self.clock(),\n            mentioned_tickers=mentioned,\n            language=\"vi\",\n        )\n\n    def _rate_limited_fetch(self, url: str) -> str:\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._last_fetch_at\n        if elapsed < self.rate_limit_seconds:\n            self.sleeper(self.rate_limit_seconds - elapsed)\n        try:\n            return self.fetcher(url)\n        finally:\n            self._last_fetch_at = time.monotonic()\n\n    def _absolute(self, href: str) -> str:\n        if href.startswith(\"http://\") or href.startswith(\"https://\"):\n            return href\n        if href.startswith(\"/\"):\n            return f\"{self.base_url}{href}\"\n        return f\"{self.base_url}/{href}\"\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _parse_published_at(soup: object) -> datetime | None:\n        \"\"\"Best-effort `<span class=\"pdate\">` or `<meta name=\"pubdate\">` parse.\n        Returns None when no recognised tag is found — the scraper falls back\n        to the wall clock at ingest time.\n        \"\"\"\n        from bs4 import BeautifulSoup, Tag\n\n        if not isinstance(soup, BeautifulSoup):\n            return None\n        for selector in (\n            (\"span\", {\"class\": \"pdate\"}),\n            (\"span\", {\"class\": \"date\"}),\n            (\"meta\", {\"name\": \"pubdate\"}),\n        ):\n            tag_name, attrs = selector\n            tag = soup.find(tag_name, attrs=attrs)\n            if not isinstance(tag, Tag):\n                continue\n            text = (\n                cast(str, tag.get(\"content\"))\n                if tag.name == \"meta\"\n                else tag.get_text(strip=True)\n            )\n            if not text:\n                continue\n            for fmt in (\"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M:%S\", \"%d-%m-%Y %H:%M\", \"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S\"):\n                try:\n                    return datetime.strptime(text, fmt).replace(tzinfo=UTC)\n                except ValueError:\n                    continue\n        return None\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _article_id(url: str) -> str:\n        return _reconfigure(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\n@click.command()\n@click.option(\"--start\", default=None, help=\"Start period label (informational; unused)\")\n@click.option(\"--end\", default=None, help=\"End period label (informational; unused)\")\n@click.option(\n    \"--output\",\n    default=\"./data/vn30-fundamentals.sqlite\",\n    show_default=True,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--rate-limit-rps\",\n    default=0.3,\n    show_default=True,\n    type=float,\n    help=\"Requests per second per provider (VCI guest tier cap = ~0.33)\",\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--tickers\",\n    default=None,\n    help=\"Comma-separated subset of VN30 to ingest (default = all 30)\",\n)\n@click.option(\"--summary\", default=None, type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path))\ndef main(\n    start: str | None,\n    end: str | None,\n    output: Path,\n    rate_limit_rps: float,\n    tickers: str | None,\n    summary: Path | None,\n) -> int:\n    _ensure_utf8_stdout()\n    _ = (start, end)  # period filtering performed adapter-side; CLI args informational\n    universe = _resolve_universe(tickers)\n    interval = max(1.0 / rate_limit_rps, 0.0) if rate_limit_rps > 0 else 0.0\n    summary_path = summary if summary is not None else output.with_name(\"vn30-fundamentals-summary.md\")\n\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] tickers={len(universe)} output={output} rate-limit={rate_limit_rps} req/sec\")\n\n    adapter = VnstockFundamentalAdapter(rate_limit_seconds=interval)\n    repo = SqliteFundamentalRepository(db_path=output)\n    peer = PeerService.from_constituents(VN30_UNIVERSE)\n\n    statements_per_ticker: dict[Ticker, list[FinancialStatement]] = {}\n    events: list[FinancialStatementFiled] = []\n    failures: list[tuple[Ticker, str, str]] = []\n\n    for t in universe:\n        sector = peer.get_sector(t)\n        all_for_ticker: list[FinancialStatement] = []\n        for st in (StatementType.IS, StatementType.BS, StatementType.CF):\n            fetched = _fetch(adapter, t, st, failures)\n            for s in fetched:\n                if sector is not None and s.sector is None:\n                    s = _attach_sector(s, sector)\n                all_for_ticker.append(s)\n                events.append(_to_event(s))\n        statements_per_ticker[t] = all_for_ticker\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] {t.symbol}: {len(all_for_ticker)} statements\")\n\n    written = repo.save_many_by_ticker(statements_per_ticker)\n    total = sum(written.values())\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] wrote {total} rows; total in db = {repo.count()}\")\n    _write_summary(summary_path, written, failures, len(events))\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] summary written: {summary_path}\")\n    click.echo(\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] OK\")\n    return 0\n\n\ndef _resolve_universe(subset: str | None) -> Sequence[Ticker]:\n    if subset is None:\n        return vn30_tickers()\n    requested = [Ticker(s.strip()) for s in subset.split(\",\") if s.strip()]\n    valid = {c.ticker.symbol for c in VN30_UNIVERSE}\n    invalid = [t.symbol for t in requested if t.symbol not in valid]\n    if invalid:\n        raise click.UsageError(f\"--tickers contains non-VN30 entries: {invalid}\")\n    return requested\n\n\ndef _fetch(\n    adapter: VnstockFundamentalAdapter,\n    ticker: Ticker,\n    statement_type: StatementType,\n    failures: list[tuple[Ticker, str, str]],\n) -> list[FinancialStatement]:\n    try:\n        return list(adapter.fetch_statements(ticker, statement_type))\n    except VnstockFundamentalAdapterError as exc:\n        message = str(exc)\n        if \"rate limit\" in message.lower():\n            click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] rate-limited on {ticker.symbol}; sleeping 30s + retry once\", err=True)\n            time.sleep(30)\n            try:\n                return list(adapter.fetch_statements(ticker, statement_type))\n            except VnstockFundamentalAdapterError as exc2:\n                message = str(exc2)\n        click.echo(f\"[ingest_fundamentals_vn30] FAILED on {ticker.symbol}/{statement_type.value}: {message}\", err=True)\n        failures.append((ticker, statement_type.value, message))\n        return []\n\n\ndef _attach_sector(statement: FinancialStatement, sector: str) -> FinancialStatement:\n    return FinancialStatement(\n        ticker=statement.ticker,\n        statement_type=statement.statement_type,\n        period_end=statement.period_end,\n        filing_date=statement.filing_date,\n        ingested_at=statement.ingested_at,\n        line_items=statement.line_items,\n        source_provider=statement.source_provider,\n        sector=sector,\n        restated_at=statement.restated_at,\n        fiscal_period_label=statement.fiscal_period_label,\n    )\n\n\ndef _to_event(s: FinancialStatement) -> FinancialStatementFiled:\n    return FinancialStatementFiled(\n        ticker=s.ticker,\n        statement_type=s.statement_type.value,\n        period_end=s.period_end,\n        filing_date=s.filing_date,\n        source_provider=s.source_provider,\n        emitted_at=datetime.now(UTC),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write_summary(\n    path: Path,\n    written: dict[Ticker, int],\n    failures: list[tuple[Ticker, str, str]],\n    event_count: int,\n) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    lines: list[str] = [\n        \"# VN30 Fundamentals Ingestion Summary\",\n        \"\",\n        f\"**Tickers ingested**: {len(written)} / 30\",\n        f\"**Total rows written**: {sum(written.values())}\",\n        f\"**Events emitted**: {event_count}\",\n        \"\",\n        \"## Per-ticker outcome\",\n        \"\",\n        \"| Ticker | rows_written |\",\n        \"|---|---|\",\n    ]\n    for ticker, n in written.items():\n        lines.append(f\"| {ticker.symbol} | {n} |\")\n    if failures:\n        lines += [\"\", \"## Failures\", \"\"]\n        for t, st, msg in failures:\n            lines.append(f\"- **{t.symbol}** [{st}]: {msg}\")\n    path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main(standalone_mode=False) or Emit NewsArticleIngested + ExtractedClaimPublished events synchronously.\n\nPhase 2 thin slice ($50 sandbox cap; nightly automation deferred to Phase 3).\n\nRun:\n  python apps/cli/ingest_news_cafef.py --tickers VN30 --max-articles 100 \\\\\n    --output ./data/vn30-news.sqlite --skip-llm\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sys\nimport time\nfrom collections.abc import Sequence\nfrom datetime import UTC, datetime\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport click\n\nfrom packages.contracts import (\n    ExtractedClaimPublished,\n    NewsArticleIngested,\n    Ticker,\n)\nfrom packages.domain.market_data import VN30_UNIVERSE, vn30_tickers\nfrom packages.domain.news import (\n    ClaimExtractionService,\n    ExtractedClaim,\n    NewsArticle,\n)\nfrom packages.infrastructure.news import (\n    CafeFScraper,\n    ClaudeLlmExtractor,\n    SqliteClaimRepository,\n    SqliteNewsRepository,\n)\n\n\ndef _ensure_utf8_stdout() -> None:\n    _reconfigure = getattr(sys.stdout, \"reconfigure\", None)\n    if callable(_reconfigure):\n        _reconfigure(encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef _httpx_fetcher(url: str) -> str:\n    import httpx  # local import — adapter substrate\n\n    headers = {\n        \"User-Agent\": (\n            \"stockforge-research-bot/0.0.1 \"\n            \"(+contact: nathanleewindy@gmail.com)\"\n        ),\n        \"Accept-Language\": \"vi,en;q=0.8\",\n    }\n    response = httpx.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=15.0)\n    response.raise_for_status()\n    return response.text\n\n\n@click.command()\n@click.option(\n    \"--tickers\",\n    default=\"VN30\",\n    show_default=True,\n    help='Either \"VN30\" or comma-separated symbols (e.g. \"VHM,FPT\").',\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--since\",\n    default=None,\n    help=\"Filter articles published >= ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).\",\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--max-articles\",\n    default=100,\n    show_default=True,\n    type=int,\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--listing\",\n    default=\"/thi-truong-chung-khoan.chn\",\n    show_default=True,\n    help=\"CafeF section landing page path.\",\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--output\",\n    default=\"./data/vn30-news.sqlite\",\n    show_default=True,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--skip-llm\",\n    is_flag=True,\n    default=False,\n    help=\"Skip claim extraction (article ingestion only). Default extracts.\",\n)\n@click.option(\n    \"--summary\",\n    default=None,\n    type=click.Path(dir_okay=False, path_type=Path),\n)\ndef main(\n    tickers: str,\n    since: str | None,\n    max_articles: int,\n    listing: str,\n    output: Path,\n    skip_llm: bool,\n    summary: Path | None,\n) -> int:\n    _ensure_utf8_stdout()\n    universe = _resolve_universe(tickers)\n    since_dt = (\n        datetime.fromisoformat(since).replace(tzinfo=UTC) if since else None\n    )\n    summary_path = (\n        summary if summary is not None\n        else output.with_name(\"vn30-news-summary.md\")\n    )\n\n    click.echo(\n        f\"[ingest_news_cafef] universe={len(universe)} listing={listing} \"\n        f\"max-articles={max_articles} output={output} skip-llm={skip_llm}\"\n    )\n\n    scraper = CafeFScraper(fetcher=_httpx_fetcher)\n    news_repo = SqliteNewsRepository(db_path=output)\n    claim_repo = SqliteClaimRepository(db_path=output)\n\n    articles = _scrape_articles(\n        scraper=scraper,\n        listing=listing,\n        max_articles=max_articles,\n        universe=universe,\n        since=since_dt,\n    )\n    written_articles = news_repo.save_many(articles)\n    article_events = [_to_news_event(a) for a in articles]\n    click.echo(\n        f\"[ingest_news_cafef] articles_scraped={len(articles)} \"\n        f\"articles_written={written_articles} \"\n        f\"with_ticker_mention={sum(1 for a in articles if a.mentioned_tickers)}\"\n    )\n\n    claims: list[ExtractedClaim] = []\n    if not skip_llm:\n        extractor = ClaudeLlmExtractor()\n        service = ClaimExtractionService(\n            extractor=extractor, claim_repo=claim_repo\n        )\n        claims = _extract_claims(service, articles, extractor)\n        claim_events = [_to_claim_event(c) for c in claims]\n        click.echo(\n            f\"[ingest_news_cafef] claims_extracted={len(claims)} \"\n            f\"events_emitted={len(article_events)}/{len(claim_events)}\"\n        )\n    else:\n        click.echo(\"[ingest_news_cafef] skip-llm enabled; no extraction\")\n\n    _write_summary(summary_path, articles, claims, article_events)\n    click.echo(f\"[ingest_news_cafef] summary written: {summary_path}\")\n    click.echo(\"[ingest_news_cafef] OK\")\n    return 0\n\n\ndef _resolve_universe(tickers_arg: str) -> Sequence[Ticker]:\n    if tickers_arg.upper() == \"VN30\":\n        return vn30_tickers()\n    requested = [\n        Ticker(s.strip()) for s in tickers_arg.split(\",\") if s.strip()\n    ]\n    valid = {c.ticker.symbol for c in VN30_UNIVERSE}\n    invalid = [t.symbol for t in requested if t.symbol not in valid]\n    if invalid:\n        raise click.UsageError(\n            f\"--tickers contains non-VN30 entries: {invalid}\"\n        )\n    return requested\n\n\ndef _scrape_articles(\n    *,\n    scraper: CafeFScraper,\n    listing: str,\n    max_articles: int,\n    universe: Sequence[Ticker],\n    since: datetime | None,\n) -> list[NewsArticle]:\n    try:\n        urls = scraper.discover(listing, max_articles=max_articles)\n    except Exception as exc:  # vendor-drift L-S28-1 doctrine\n        click.echo(\n            f\"[ingest_news_cafef] discovery FAILED: {exc}\", err=True\n        )\n        return []\n    out: list[NewsArticle] = []\n    for url in urls:\n        scraped = scraper.fetch_article(url)\n        if scraped is None:\n            continue\n        if since is not None and scraped.published_at < since:\n            continue\n        out.append(scraper.to_news_article(scraped, universe))\n    return out\n\n\ndef _extract_claims(\n    service: ClaimExtractionService,\n    articles: list[NewsArticle],\n    extractor: ClaudeLlmExtractor,\n) -> list[ExtractedClaim]:\n    relevant = [a for a in articles if a.mentioned_tickers]\n    persisted = service.process(relevant)\n    if persisted == 0:\n        return []\n    return [c for a in relevant for c in extractor.extract(a)]\n\n\ndef _to_news_event(article: NewsArticle) -> NewsArticleIngested:\n    return NewsArticleIngested(\n        article_id=article.article_id,\n        source=article.source,\n        source_url=article.source_url,\n        published_at=article.published_at,\n        ingested_at=article.ingested_at,\n        mentioned_tickers=article.mentioned_tickers,\n        emitted_at=datetime.now(UTC),\n    )\n\n\ndef _to_claim_event(claim: ExtractedClaim) -> ExtractedClaimPublished:\n    return ExtractedClaimPublished(\n        claim_id=claim.claim_id,\n        article_id=claim.article_id,\n        source_url=claim.source_url,\n        sentiment=claim.sentiment.value,\n        mentioned_tickers=claim.mentioned_tickers,\n        mentioned_sectors=claim.mentioned_sectors,\n        extractor_model=claim.extractor.extractor_model,\n        extracted_at=claim.extractor.extracted_at,\n        confidence_extracted=claim.extractor.confidence_extracted,\n        emitted_at=datetime.now(UTC),\n    )\n\n\ndef _write_summary(\n    path: Path,\n    articles: list[NewsArticle],\n    claims: list[ExtractedClaim],\n    article_events: list[NewsArticleIngested],\n) -> None:\n    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    with_mention = [a for a in articles if a.mentioned_tickers]\n    sentiment_counts: dict[str, int] = {}\n    for c in claims:\n        sentiment_counts[c.sentiment.value] = (\n            sentiment_counts.get(c.sentiment.value, 0) + 1\n        )\n    lines: list[str] = [\n        \"# CafeF News Ingestion Summary\",\n        \"\",\n        f\"**Articles scraped**: {len(articles)}\",\n        f\"**Articles with ≥1 ticker mention**: {len(with_mention)}\",\n        f\"**Claims extracted**: {len(claims)}\",\n        f\"**Article events emitted**: {len(article_events)}\",\n        \"\",\n        \"## Sentiment distribution (categorical per Rule 7)\",\n        \"\",\n        \"| Sentiment | Count |\",\n        \"|---|---|\",\n    ]\n    for label in (\n        \"strongly_bullish\",\n        \"bullish\",\n        \"neutral\",\n        \"bearish\",\n        \"strongly_bearish\",\n    ):\n        lines.append(f\"| {label} | {sentiment_counts.get(label, 0)} |\")\n    if articles:\n        lines += [\n            \"\",\n            \"## First 5 articles\",\n            \"\",\n        ]\n        for a in articles[:5]:\n            tag = \",\".join(t.symbol for t in a.mentioned_tickers) or \"—\"\n            lines.append(f\"- [{a.title}]({a.source_url}) tickers={tag}\")\n    path.write_text(\"\\n\".join(lines) + \"\\n\", encoding=\"utf-8\")\n\n\n# Quiet a never-used `time` import warning when --skip-llm path is taken; the\n# rate limiter inside CafeFScraper consumes time.sleep but ruff scans only\n# this module's direct usage.\n_ = time\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    sys.exit(main(standalone_mode=False) or 0)\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":1,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3481,"cache_read_input_tokens":129543,"output_tokens":4093,"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3481,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[{"input_tokens":1,"output_tokens":4093,"cache_read_input_tokens":129543,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3481,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3481},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard"},"diagnostics":null},"requestId":"req_011CaavUcS2xFJzK68xiA5bt","type":"assistant","uuid":"77a39ac3-cf8f-4a32-8603-c25781a9b346","timestamp":"2026-05-01T00:43:52.922Z","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"C:\\htdocs\\stockforge","sessionId":"7bf27696-2c05-47b0-b800-b80ca0c05110","version":"2.1.123","gitBranch":"main"}

FPT cũng tăng trưởng.</p>\n</div>\n</body></html>\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _frozen_clock() -> datetime:\n    return datetime(2026, 5, 1, 9, 5, tzinfo=UTC)\n\n\ndef _make_scraper(pages: dict[str, str]) -> CafeFScraper:\n    def fetcher(url: str) -> str:\n        if url in pages:\n            return pages[url]\n        for path, html in pages.items():\n            if url.endswith(path):\n                return html\n        raise RuntimeError(f\"unexpected url: {url}\")\n\n    return CafeFScraper(\n        fetcher=fetcher,\n        clock=_frozen_clock,\n        sleeper=lambda _s: None,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_scraper_discovers_chn_urls_and_dedupes() -> None:\n    scraper = _make_scraper({\"/thi-truong.chn\": _LISTING_HTML})\n    urls = scraper.discover(\"/thi-truong.chn\", max_articles=10)\n    assert \"https://cafef.vn/vhm-quy-1.chn\" in urls\n    assert \"https://cafef.vn/fpt-doanh-thu.chn\" in urls\n    assert \"https://cafef.vn/about.html\" not in [u for u in urls]\n    # dedupe\n    assert urls.count(\"https://cafef.vn/vhm-quy-1.chn\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_scraper_respects_max_articles_cap() -> None:\n    scraper = _make_scraper({\"/thi-truong.chn\": _LISTING_HTML})\n    urls = scraper.discover(\"/thi-truong.chn\", max_articles=1)\n    assert len(urls) == 1\n\n\ndef test_scraper_fetch_article_returns_scraped_with_title_and_body() -> None:\n    scraper = _make_scraper(\n        {\"https://cafef.vn/vhm-quy-1.chn\": _ARTICLE_HTML}\n    )\n    scraped = scraper.fetch_article(\"https://cafef.vn/vhm-quy-1.chn\")\n    assert scraped is not None\n    assert \"VHM\" in scraped.title\n    assert \"Vinhomes\" in scraped.body_text\n    assert scraped.published_at == datetime(2026, 5, 1, 9, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\n\n\ndef test_scraper_returns_none_on_missing_body() -> None:\n    scraper = _make_scraper(\n        {\"https://cafef.vn/x.chn\": \"<html><body><h1>title</h1></body></html>\"}\n    )\n    assert self.version = \"0.0\"\n            self.system_prompt = \"stub\"\n            self.transport = lambda system, body: \"\"\n            self.clock = lambda: datetime(2026, 5, 1, 10, 0, tzinfo=UTC)\n\n        @property\n        def prompt_hash(self) -> str:\n            return \"stub-hash\"\n\n        def extract(self, article: NewsArticle) -> list[ExtractedClaim]:\n            captured.append(article)\n            if not article.mentioned_tickers:\n                return []\n            meta = ExtractorMetadata(\n                extractor_model=\"stub\",\n                extractor_version=\"0.0\",\n                extractor_prompt_hash=\"stub-hash\",\n                extracted_at=datetime(2026, 5, 1, 10, 0, tzinfo=UTC),\n                confidence_extracted=0.8,\n            )\n            return [\n                ExtractedClaim(\n                    claim_id=f\"{article.article_id}:0\",\n                    article_id=article.article_id,\n                    source_url=article.source_url,\n                    source_text_excerpt=\"recorded excerpt\",\n                    claim_text=f\"claim for {article.title}\",\n Two design constraints drive the shape:\n\n1. **Fixture-driven CI**: tests inject recorded HTML via the `fetcher` callable\n   so CI never hits cafef.vn. The default fetcher (`_httpx_fetcher`) uses\n   httpx with a 1-req/2-sec rate limit per spec-T1-001 § B.9 (ToS-respecting).\n2. **Robust selector failure**: CafeF mutates HTML quarterly; we extract via\n   resilient BeautifulSoup queries and emit `ScrapedArticle` only when title +\n   URL + body excerpt are non-empty.
